occurrences.text: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.
For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.
words: them they are in the terrors

occurrences.text: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.
Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud.
And behold at eveningtide trouble; and before the morning he is not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.
I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt be no more: though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord God.
The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt be any more.
words: at thee thou shalt be a terror

occurrences.text: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt thou be any more.
